# extra tools and is not listed here. Scratch itself is left out on purpose: its Flathub wrapper is unverified and over six

column4: Read Wikipedia and other libraries with no internet. The app is small; the libraries are separate downloads you choose yourself (from 0.3 GB to about 50 GB).
Free school lessons, videos and exercises that work offline. Lesson channels are optional extra downloads and can be very large.
Learning games for young children: letters, numbers, shapes, music and more. Free and works offline.
A planetarium for your computer. Shows the real night sky from anywhere, with stars, planets and constellations.
Draw graphs, shapes and equations and see how they change. Works offline for school maths.
Learn to code by snapping colourful blocks together. A fast, free editor for Scratch projects. Works offline.
Private chat that needs no company server. Messages go straight between devices, by Tor on the internet or by Bluetooth and Wi-Fi when the internet is down.
Talk to a Meshtastic radio to send short messages with no phone signal or internet. You need a Meshtastic radio to use it.
Run Android apps in a window on this computer. The first start downloads an Android image of about 1 GB. Needs a recent Wayland desktop.
Turns a folder of notes, code or documents into a map you can search and ask questions about. Runs on this computer.
